blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Friday upheld its resolution allowing former Sen. Bong Revilla to post bail in his malversation case after denying the prosecution’s motion for reconsideration. On the other hand, the court said it has denied the motions filed by the other accused, Brice Ericson Hernandez, Arjay Domasig, Jaypee Mendoza, Juanito Mendoza, Emelita Juat and Christina Pineda, who were seeking reconsideration of the denial of their respective petitions for bail.
